clips.title: The story
paras: Along Hillsbrad's coast, Lieutenant Farren Orinelle leaves Southshore's defense to passing adventurers. Sent from Stormwind, he would rather drink ale than patrol, even as Torn Fin murlocs gather along the Western Strand.

Lieutenant Farren Orinelle left Stormwind's city guard for a post in Southshore. The port feels dreary to him, and he cannot bear the fishy harbor odor. He spends his days drinking at the inn instead of patrolling the frontlines. Marshal Redpath has ordered him to protect Southshore from the dangers nearby, but Orinelle hires passing sellswords to do the work.

The Western Strand runs along the coast west of Southshore. Orinelle scoffs at the murlocs as overgrown fish, but the Torn Fin tribe threatens coastal travel and local shipping. Its tidehunters and oracles gather in camps along the breakers and ambush anyone who strays too far from town walls. Clearing the shoreline means facing them there.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Transferred from the Stormwind city guard to Southshore, a town that should be abandoned by the looks of it... Smell of the harbor day and night.
Not to mention ol' Redpath... Wants me to take care of the murlocs. Ha!
I can barely rouse myself to go out to some of the pockets of the overgrown fish down the Western Strand. If you would go in my place and take care of them, I'd appreciate it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Another ale, please, the last one just seemed to have disappeared!
Light, how much longer am I going to be stuck out here?
Oh, it's you, friend. Have you killed those murlocs yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I hope this will be enough to convince Redpath that I've—ha!--been carrying out his orders and ridding Southshore of the terrible and horrible menace of the dreaded murlocs!
For there could be no greater evil than the ravages of overgrown fish!
